title: Open Booking Limits, Recurring Series and Visit Intervals for In-Person Appointments
content:
The scheduling system for In-Person Appointments holds, for each visit type, a limit on how many appointments of that type one patient may hold open at once, whether the type may be booked as a recurring series and how long such a series may run, the minimum interval between two completed visits of the type, and the period without a completed visit in a department after which a patient books as a new patient.

| Visit type | Open appointments of the type per patient (booked or confirmed) | Recurring series allowed | Maximum appointments in one series | Minimum months between completed visits | New-patient look-back (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 6 | Yes | 12 | 0 (no limit) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 2 | No | 0 (series not allowed) | 0 (no limit) | 0 (not applicable) |
| New Patient Office Visit | 1 | No | 0 (series not allowed) | 0 (no limit) | 36 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 1 | No | 0 (series not allowed) | 12 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Specialist Consultation | 2 | No | 0 (series not allowed) | 0 (no limit) | 0 (not applicable) |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 2 | No | 0 (series not allowed) | 0 (no limit) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 2 | No | 0 (series not allowed) | 0 (no limit) | 0 (not applicable) |

**Definitions carried by the table**

1. *Open appointments per patient* is the greatest number of appointments of the visit type a patient may hold open, meaning booked or confirmed, at the same time.
2. *Recurring series allowed* records whether the visit type may be booked as a recurring series, for example allergy injections; *maximum appointments in one series* is the ceiling for one such series, and a figure of 0 means a series is not allowed.
3. *Minimum months between completed visits* is the preventive frequency limit, in calendar months; 0 means no limit.
4. *New-patient look-back* is the number of months without a completed visit in the same department after which the patient books as a new patient; 0 means the figure does not apply to the visit type.

**Points of judgement**

- The Nurse Visit is the only visit type with Yes for a recurring series, and its series may hold up to 12 appointments.
- The Annual Preventive Exam is the only visit type carrying an interval figure, 12 months.
- The New Patient Office Visit is the only visit type carrying a new-patient look-back, 36 months.
